question: The catchphrase of which census is ‘Our census, our future’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2011**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The catchphrase **'Our census, our future'** was used for the **2011 Census of India**.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National census survey conducted by the Census Organization of India.
